evidenceBoundary.direct: Supplied quest/condition identities and signed numeric entry argument, with separate typed pre-entry condition cache fields on the selected build.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Entry does not prove the invocation source, live IFix selection, successful request construction/send, server acceptance, numeric incoming objective-map contents, result evaluation or the condition's actual runtime subtype. The separately reviewed current default-body request construction is not proved by capture preparation or carried across builds by this role label.

evidenceBoundary.direct: Mission and quest transition entries, SNS read/content/option entries, dialog trunk/option/finish entries, script and task identities, source path hashes and authored ActionMap node identifiers. Every signature and typed field path must resolve independently on the selected installed build.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Captured raw pointers, anonymous carrier state and 64-bit path hashes require separately authenticated static source joins.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: A complete observed route requires prelaunch installation of all hooks, no event/read loss, bounded nontruncated strings, clean stop, and native/source authentication; focusMission labels the run and never filters nearby context.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Method entry does not prove success/return, UI display, dialogue audio playback, cross-thread or asynchronous causal ownership, missed pre-capture actions, or order of unvisited branches. No lists/dictionaries, game methods, getters or runtime state mutation are used. Preparation authenticates entry identities, signatures, typed storage and enum definitions; it does not prove selected body control flow. Default-body relationships are separately reviewed/evaluated by mission_shared_native and must not be carried across builds from these role labels.

coverageGaps: Entry-only observers do not capture return values, float-register argument values, IFix path selection, server acceptance or asynchronous ownership.

Maps/repeated collections are not traversed: initial mission/dialog dictionaries, incoming mission objective numeric values/extraDetails, dialog option/finish wire lists, and the full LevelScript conditionCompletedMap remain unsampled.

Typed task tracking retains the supplied objectiveIndex/completionBool. Its current reviewed caller supplies objectiveEnum; preparation does not prove that control flow on another build. No unique conditionId or unchanged incoming map member is retained.

Global condition polling getters and result/progress setters are omitted to avoid unproved volume. GameCondition.set_progress also lacks a bounded current .pdata body; condition lifecycle snapshots do not replace per-change numeric progress events.
A stored parentQuestId is explicit receiver context; null values remain a coverage gap and timestamp proximity never supplies missing ownership.

Base-typed condition storage and observed declared method families do not authenticate the receiver's actual runtime subtype. Named numeric progress requests do not replace incoming objective-map delivery or a successful send/acknowledgment.
